name: Storefront for Art and Architecture
notes:
Architecture-focused nonprofit, included here for the institutions layer. Site itself noted the space as "currently closed" alongside a live exhibition listing — possibly between-install or appointment-only. 2026-08-17 re-check: the specific program page (storefront.nyc/program/longings-returns-by-sim-chi-yin/) confirms Aug 8-29 dates and curator credits directly, corroborated by 3+ independent listings (ArtRabbit, Mato, Storefront's own Facebook) — the homepage's stale "closed" text is likely just an unrelated visiting-hours banner, not evidence this show isn't on view. Also corrected cadence from an incorrectly-set 'daily' to 'weekly' per SPEC.md §6 (show doesn't open/close within 7 days of 2026-08-17). Image search (2026-08-18): the program page's gallery component confirms installation photography by Luis Corzo (credit visible in rendered content) but doesn't expose actual image src URLs to a non-browser fetch — image_urls left empty rather than guessed; worth revisiting once a real adapter can render the JS gallery.

Fingerprint (2026-08-18): wordpress — /wp-json/ reachable.
